name: Shani Sanshani
original_name: シャニ・サンシャーニ
source:
[u][b]The Puppy-like Ghost Oppai Spy![/b][/u]
Race: Ghost
Code Name: Stand 
First Year at Espiona Girls' Academy
Assigned Class: Snake Unit
Club: Spy Cheerleading Club

Shani is a first-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and is a ghost. She is one of the top students in the Snake Unit, a class specializing in infiltration and stealth.

A rare race even within the academy, she is a ghost girl. Normally, ghosts cannot physically interact with other beings, but she overcame this limitation thanks to a magical potion created by Isolte, an authority in magical pharmacology and Safia’s mother. Not only can she turn herself invisible, but she can also make anything or anyone she touches disappear along with her. She can even pass through walls, allowing her to move around the academy using shortcuts and live quite conveniently.

Her personality is extremely cheerful, energetic, and headstrong, always running around at full speed. Because she is so different from the typical image of her race, people often question whether she is really a ghost. She is also a member of the cheerleading club, making her even less ghost-like. Recently, she seems to view a tall, well-endowed transfer student who appeared at a nearby academy like a shooting star as her rival.

She has always thought ninjas were incredibly cool, so she has become very attached to the protagonist, who came from another world. She plans to one day make him her master, become a ninja herself, and call herself “Ghost of Ninja.” She follows him around like a puppy and often sings her own homemade ninja songs.

Her codename is “Stand,” derived from her ghostly ability to appear behind her target. Her ability as a spy is stealth through invisibility. Because she cannot be seen and can pass through walls, her skills would normally place her among the strongest spies. However, despite having perfect abilities, her personality is her biggest flaw, as she cannot stay still or remain quiet. She is constantly trying to break the habit of speaking out loud and running around.

Her boobs are O-cups, with a “puppy-like, playful bowl" shape. They are still developing, and she confidently believes she has the potential to surpass her senior Safia someday. Her specialty in honey traps is what she calls the “Ghost Invisible Harassment Trap.”

Her hobbies are karaoke and running, while she dislikes silence and staying still. She also has a distinctive way of speaking, often ending her sentences with “–de arimasu!”

Her mother, Shaydi, is a teacher at the academy and handles stealth classes. She is quiet and somewhat fragile in demeanor, fitting the typical image of her race, and often wonders how she ended up with a daughter like Shani. Despite their completely different personalities, they have a good relationship and often go out together on their days off.

•Boobs: 110 cm ~ “They bounce just like a cheerleader’s pom-poms!”
•Nipples: 4.4 mm (Height) ~ “Paisen♥ Poking them too much is a no-go♥”
•Areola: 3.1 cm (Diameter) ~ “You’re particular about this too? As expected of paisen…”

•Hips: 80 cm ~ “It’s not quite ‘booming’ yet”
•Thighs: 39.8 cm (Thickness) ~ “Want to squeeze here? As expected of a sexual harassment ninja!”
•Vagina: 3.5 cm (Full Length) ~ “You must not infiltrate there♥”
